'''Ark Rutendo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] who served with the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was present with other Wing Guardsmen just prior to the [[Occupation of Bespin]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

Rutendo was also a meteorologist who was often found at [[Kerros Tower]],<ref name="SWI" /> predicting upcoming storms and weather patterns.
